chunks: And with this chain, from Ahmad ibn Abi Abdillah, from Ibn Fadhal, from Abdullah ibn Bukayr, who said:
I asked Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) about the saying of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family): 'When a man commits fornication, the soul of faith departs from him.'
He (peace be upon him) said: His (God's) saying, 'And He strengthened them with a soul from Him,' that is the one which departs from him.

key_terms.قَوْلُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ: The saying of the Messenger of Allah
key_terms.يُفَارِقُهُ: It departs from him / separates from him

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'the soul of faith' in the hadith about fornication?
ai.summary: Imam al-Baqir (peace be upon him) elucidates the phrase 'the soul of faith' (ruh al-iman) in the context of fornication by linking it to the divine spirit mentioned in the Quranic verse 'And He strengthened them with a soul from Him' (8:11). This interpretation suggests that the 'soul of faith' is a distinct spiritual entity granted by God, which can be separated from the believer due to major sins, reflecting the Shia understanding of faith as a dynamic spiritual state rather than a static attribute.
